Portrait setting: The Class 1-A homeroom at U.A. Behind the character, rows of single desks with pale wooden tops and steel frames face a wide dark green chalkboard, wiped clean, and a teacher's lectern; a tall window wall runs down one side, showing campus trees and sky. At the front of the corridor-side wall stands the room's oversized door, far taller and wider than a person, built for students of every size. No other people. No readable signs or text.
